subject.title: Aliso Viejo City Council, District 3 (Short Term)

text: My wife and I moved to Aliso Viejo in 2004 and bought our home here in 2005. We have raised our kids in this community, and for 23 years I’ve worked as a mortgage advisor, helping local families with their home financing.

In October 2025 I was honored to be appointed to the City Council for District 3, and since then I immediately worked to create our Know Your Dough financial literacy program, a collaboration with Junior Achievement, two chambers of commerce and the CTE program at Aliso Niguel High School to benefit every student in the city. This program is now funded for three years.

I led our ad hoc committee that found our new city manager and I voted to approve our new pump track. I voted to lower speed limits throughout the city to improve safety for residents and I volunteer weekly at our food bank. I am also encouraging the measured growth of our city with new homes for our citizens to purchase.

I have a proven commitment to keep Aliso Viejo safe, family-friendly and fiscally sound, and I’d be grateful for your vote to continue serving the city. Please go to www.votegarrettdwyer.com for more information.

text: I want all our neighbors to feel welcome and have the city services we need to thrive here, at all stages of life. I want all our children to have the opportunity to buy a home and raise their families here, to live and work in this beautiful city, to play and grow in a safe, supportive and nurturing environment.

I was born on the Navy base in San Diego into a family dedicated to public service. I graduated from Redlands High, earned my Master's in Informatics from the University of California, Irvine and have published peer-reviewed research with internationally recognized scholars in top conferences in my field. My family has lived in Aliso Viejo for more than 20 years and I have raised my two children with the same strong moral compass and work ethic centered in community that my family instilled in me.
Support neighbors helping neighbors by voting Marie Tsaasan for District 3. Visit www.Marie4AV.com to learn more.
